summary: GLM-5.3-Flash UD-IQ2_XXS with its embedded NextN head, using MTP k=2.
note: Text only; the GLM vision tower is not implemented. Downloads all four target shards; the NextN head is embedded in the same files. Uses automatic host expert placement, BF16 latent caches, one request slot and the tested 227328-token context capacity. Requires the GLM5-Next kernels included with the matching SnowLLM build. MTP depths 1, 2 and 3 have been checked for greedy token parity, chunking and rejection; k=2 is used in the published long-context benchmarks.
